title: EAGLE board, model, KiCad file, model
how: Chain: read the EAGLE board into the model, write it as a KiCad board, read that back into the model;
compared with a tolerance of 10 nm: the counts of components, placed pads, nets, pad nets, track pieces (3), vias (1) and outline points,
the positions of pads, vias, track ends and outline points, the references with their values, the net names and the pad net names;
the KiCad writer says what it wrote (footprints, pad nets, track pieces, vias, zones, nets) and each count must equal what the reader finds.
